offering_description.value: Operates an online wholesale marketplace that connects suppliers and resellers of furniture and other bulky goods. The platform combines product discovery and transactions with fulfillment through a global logistics network.

quotes.quote: The GigaCloud B2B Marketplace is transforming the wholesale supply chain for big and bulky merchandise, seamlessly connecting suppliers and resellers worldwide. Our end-to-end platform integrates product discovery, transactions, and fulfillment, backed by a global logistics network across the U.S., U.K., Germany, Canada, and Japan. With thousands of SKUs and proprietary technology for real-time market insights, our Marketplace simplifies sourcing, selling, and shipping—creating a more efficient, connected global supply chain.
Giga Cloud Logistics is helping suppliers and resellers rapidly expand in the furniture and large goods industries with drop shipping, last mile delivery and 3PL services.
